scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustiveness through both rectangular-fibre and literal quantified semantic definitions; all claims restricted to the enumerated domain. Prior-results comparison is qualified by limits of full-text access and index coverage. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the nonempty teams of four named binary-valued variables and the 24 elementary conditional-independence atoms with singleton left and right sides are classified. Conditional independence here is relational/team independence, not probabilistic independence. No result for general finite domains or compound formulas is asserted. The exhaustive finite checker has not undergone independent human review.
title: Exact binary four-variable conditional-independence census and sharp ten-world bound
